Tinycast palette visual port
https://github.com/abue-ammar/tinycast
Commit: 37e6043f3f550febb64bdb3cff3ac29a30caad5a
License: AGPL-3.0 (see project LICENSE).

Retained Swift reference sources are not compiled into Android.
PaletteTheme.kt and PaletteUi.kt adapt Theme tokens, AppRow/SectionHeader,
outlined keycaps, the search header and floating action capsule, and the
two-column CalculatorCard into native Jetpack Compose.
Android keeps Ctrl shortcuts, accessible touch targets and its own fonts.
macOS Liquid Glass material is not available on Android.
